milestoneDetail: Standing charters, muster points, postings, grouped alerts and orders, canonical army/hearth selections, personal charter/production templates and paid production sequences are delivered. The group-travel slice adds explicit coordinated journeys: Group travel reviews compact canonical routes for up to 128 selected owned land armies ashore, then explicitly applies replacement routes or appended waypoints in stable army-ID order through ordinary commands. Current movement can be spent immediately. Resume and cancel act on eligible selected routes; existing postings remain and can resume their own movement later unless separately cleared. Accepted armies leave the selection; refused armies remain for correction. Preview context is hash-bound and advisory, with individual overrides and exact saved/replayed outcomes. Uncertain mutation responses lock orders until a saved campaign is restored; superseded preview errors do not lock a restored campaign. Verification: 2,000 headless tests across 250 files; 23 distinct affected Chromium journeys from passing runs of 21 and six with four repeated cases; one separate generated-production journey; 33 local and the same 33 live production Pages journeys passed. These overlapping scopes are not additive totals. Rules/save 32 and content 015468d1 unchanged. Theaters, patrol/escort roles, reusable army-order templates, broader governor decisions and combined mature-realm acceptance remain open. This slice does not add synchronized arrival, automatic attacks/war, standing repeat production or automatic retries.
